name: Steamed cassava
summary: Steamed cassava, fragrant and lightly sweet, with pandan or coconut cream. Some mix both. The root is chewy and rich.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động, crediting Ngôi sao, on 6 Mar 2017, and Báo Quốc tế on 11 Aug 2024, both tie steamed cassava to the tunnels and to the wartime years. It at chợ Củ Chi and chợ Việt Kiều.
howToEat: Steam it with pandan, or with coconut cream, and the root is also ground for bánh tằm. It is also steamed with pandan and sesame salt, with coconut cream mixed in.
It is sold along the roads toward Củ Chi, cooked for people at the tunnels, and named at chợ Củ Chi and chợ Việt Kiều.
where: Along the roads toward Củ Chi, at the tunnels, and at chợ Củ Chi and chợ Việt Kiều.
seoDescription: Steamed Cu Chi cassava, fragrant and lightly sweet, with pandan or coconut cream.
taste: The steamed root is fragrant and lightly sweet. With coconut cream it is chewy and rich.
